content: SQLite WAL (official sqlite.org): one writer + many concurrent readers across processes on same host; readers do not block writer in common case; SQLITE_BUSY still possible on last-connection close, crash recovery, exclusive mode - handle with busy_timeout; WAL requires shared -shm mmap, fails on network filesystems; mode is persistent on the file; never copy DB without -wal file; long-lived read transactions can starve checkpoints.
